svg.text: One Keccak-f[1600] round, and why it is one LUT6 per state bit
rho is a constant rotation and pi is a relabelling, so neither survives synthesis as logic. That leaves
theta's XOR feeding chi, and each output bit then depends on exactly six inputs -- three state bits
A'[x,y,z] = (a xor Dx) xor ( not (b xor Dx+1) and (c xor Dx+2) )
Measured out of context on xc7s100: 1600 LUT6 for the fused term, 320 LUT6 for D, 320 LUT5 for C.
